systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Counter-Current Dynamic SCW Extractor Skid (SCW-ASE)
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Subcritical Water Hydrothermal Extraction Skid (ASME Section VIII Div 1 / 3-A Standards 04-05 & 44-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.extractorReactorTechnology: Continuous Pressurized Counter-Current Tubular Column with High-Pressure Multi-Piston Feed Pump & Internal Dynamic Solid Conveyor
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (UNS S31603) & Solid Hastelloy C-276 (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm / 15 µ-in)
systemArchitectures.inLineFiltrationSystem: High-Temperature Ceramic Cross-Flow Microfiltration Membrane (0.14 µm α-Al2O3 / Zirconia Core)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Sanitary Counter-Current Chilled Glycol Tube-in-Tube Heat Exchanger (Quenches from 170°C to 24°C in <2.2 s)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: ASME Overpressure Burst Rupture Disk (110 bar), Automated Vapor-Lock Steam Suppression Relays & In-Line Dual BPR Redundancy
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous dynamic subcritical water extraction skid engineered for solvent-free recovery of high-value polyphenols, flavonoids, and antioxidants from agricultural and food processing byproducts. Operates under pressurized sub-boiling hydrothermal conditions (120–220°C, 30–80 bar) to tune water's dielectric constant down to ethanol-like levels (ε ≈ 30–35), dissolving semi-polar and non-polar phytocompounds without organic solvents (0.00 ppm VOC residue).

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial Twin-Column Reciprocating Packed-Bed Accelerated Solvent Extraction Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Semicontinuous Botanical Active Ingredient Fractionation Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 cGMP / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.extractorReactorTechnology: Automated Dual-Column Reciprocating Packed Bed with Sintered Porous 316L Flow Distributors & Continuous Superheated Water Inflow
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Forged AISI 316L Stainless Steel with Electropolished Internal Liners and USP Class VI Perfluoroelastomer Seals
systemArchitectures.inLineFiltrationSystem: Multi-Cartridge Sintered Porous Titanium Metal Microfiltration Element (0.50 µm Retention)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Integrated Multi-Pass Counter-Current Chilled Glycol Shell-and-Tube Exchanger (Heat Transfer Area 5.8 m²)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Hydraulic Safety Relief Valves, Pneumatic Column Switching Interlocks & Continuous Thermal Runaway Cutoffs
systemArchitectures.description: Designed for commercial nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturing facilities requiring high volumetric processing of botanical pomace and leaves. Alternates between two extraction columns, permitting continuous solvent flow while the off-line column undergoes rapid hydraulic depressurization, cake discharge, and fresh botanical reloading.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary Dynamic High-Shear Micro-Cavitation Subcritical Water Reactor Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Dynamic Hydrothermal Cell Disruption & Bioactive Extraction System (3-A 74-07 / EHEDG Clean-In-Place Validated)
systemArchitectures.extractorReactorTechnology: Continuous Pressurized Rotor-Stator Hydrothermal Shearing Cavitation Head Coupled to Pressurized Plug-Flow Loop
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Titanium Grade 5 Micro-Rotor with Electropolished AISI 316L Stator Housing (Ra ≤ 0.25 µm)
systemArchitectures.inLineFiltrationSystem: In-Line Dynamic Tubular Ceramic Membrane Concentrator (0.20 µm Pore Size)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Instantaneous Dual-Stage Chilled Brine Micro-Channel Heat Exchanger (<1.4 s Residence Quench)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Hydrodynamic Cavitation Vibration Spectrum Sensors, High-Temperature Seal Flush Overpressure Interlocks & Emergency Cold Injection Valve
systemArchitectures.description: High-efficiency micro-dispersion skid combining intense hydrodynamic mechanical shear with superheated subcritical water solvating power. Mechanically disrupts rigid plant cell walls (lignocellulose matrix) while superheated subcritical water dissolves bound bioactives in seconds with minimum solvent consumption.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Pilot Modular Subcritical Multi-Zone Fractionation Research Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Modular GMP Pilot Extraction & Fractionation Skid (ISO 7 Class 10,000 Cleanroom / FDA 21 CFR § 117 & § 211)
systemArchitectures.extractorReactorTechnology: Multi-Zone Temperature-Stepped Gradient Extraction Columns (Three In-Line Heating Stages: 110°C, 150°C, 185°C)
systemArchitectures.productContactMetallurgy: Solid Vacuum-Melted Hastelloy C-22 Flow Conduits & Diamond-Coated Valve Plugs (Ra ≤ 0.20 µm / 8 µ-in)
systemArchitectures.inLineFiltrationSystem: Dual Ultra-Clean Ceramic Cross-Flow Modules (0.10 µm α-Alumina & 30 kDa Zirconia Ultrafilter)
systemArchitectures.inLineQuenchSystem: Peltier-Assisted Sanitary Micro-Plate Chiller with Instantaneous Cryo-Glycol Boost
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Optical Backpressure Transducers, Dual Rupture Disks & 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Batch Record Data Logger
systemArchitectures.description: Precision pilot research and pharmaceutical-grade botanical validation skid designed for selective fractional recovery of target phytocompounds. Uses stepped temperature ramping to fractionally isolate polar anthocyanins at low temperatures before ramping to higher subcritical temperatures to extract non-polar aglycones and flavonoids.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Red Grape Pomace & Skin Residue (Vitis vinifera)
botanicalSubstrates.primaryTargetBioactives: Anthocyanins (Malvidin-3-glucoside, Peonidin), trans-Resveratrol, Proanthocyanidins & Gallic Acid
botanicalSubstrates.description: Pressurized hot subcritical water at 135°C cleaves hydrogen-bonded anthocyanin monoglucosides from grape skin pectin matrices and dissolves poorly soluble trans-resveratrol without requiring ethanol-water solvents or producing hazardous solvent vapors.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Green Tea Spent Leaves & Fine Residue (Camellia sinensis)
botanicalSubstrates.primaryTargetBioactives: Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG), Epigallocatechin (EGC), Epicatechin Gallate (ECG) & Theanine
botanicalSubstrates.description: Subcritical water extraction at 145°C accelerates the mass transfer of catechins through tea leaf cuticular waxes, recovering over 93% of native EGCG while suppressing oxidative epimerization into GCG through continuous nitrogen deoxygenation.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Sweet Orange & Grapefruit Peel Byproduct (Citrus sinensis / paradisi)
botanicalSubstrates.description: Hesperidin and naringin have virtually zero solubility in water at 25°C (<0.02 g/L). At 160°C and 55 bar, subcritical water's dielectric constant drops to ~39.5, elevating flavanone solubility by more than 180-fold and recovering intact dietary bioflavonoids cleanly.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Red Onion Outer Tunic Skin & Apple Pomace (Allium cepa / Malus domestica)
botanicalSubstrates.primaryTargetBioactives: Quercetin Aglycone, Quercetin-4'-O-β-D-glucoside, Rutin, Chlorogenic Acid & Phloridzin
botanicalSubstrates.description: Superheated subcritical water acts as both solvent and mild auto-catalyst: hydronium ions generated by water's elevated ionization product (Kw) catalyze the hydrothermal deglycosylation of quercetin glucosides into bioavailable quercetin aglycone in under 4 minutes.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Wild Elderberry & Blackcurrant Press-Cake (Sambucus nigra / Ribes nigrum)
botanicalSubstrates.description: Thermolabile berry anthocyanins are vulnerable to thermal degradation. At a mild subcritical temperature of 125°C under 40 bar pressure, water's polarity is reduced sufficiently for quantitative anthocyanin recovery while rapid 3.5-minute flow prevents color loss.

botanicalSubstrates.name: Olive Orchard Pruning Leaves & Two-Phase Mill Pomace (Olea europaea)
botanicalSubstrates.description: Continuous SCW extraction recovers oleuropein and simultaneously triggers controlled hydrothermal hydrolysis into hydroxytyrosol—one of the most potent natural phenolic antioxidants recognized under EFSA health claims for cardiovascular protection.

filtrationMembranes.name: High-Temperature Ceramic Cross-Flow Microfiltration (0.14 µm α-Al2O3 / Zirconia)
filtrationMembranes.cleanInPlaceProcedure: Hot caustic flush (1.5% NaOH at 85°C) followed by 1.0% citric acid backwash
filtrationMembranes.description: Rigid tubular ceramic multichannel membrane designed for continuous clarification of superheated botanical extracts directly at operating temperature and pressure, eliminating downstream centrifuges and filter aids.

filtrationMembranes.name: Sintered Porous Titanium Metal Microfiltration Element (0.50 µm Retention)
filtrationMembranes.cleanInPlaceProcedure: Forward high-pressure steam blowback and ultrasonic peracetic acid cleaning
filtrationMembranes.description: Heavy-duty sintered porous metal core engineered for coarse fibrous botanical slurries (spent tea leaves, grape pomace) with extreme hydraulic burst resistance up to 120 bar differential.

filtrationMembranes.name: Sanitary Tubular Zirconia Ultrafiltration Membrane (50 kDa MWCO)
filtrationMembranes.cleanInPlaceProcedure: Thermal enzyme wash (alkaline protease at 60°C) with periodic nitric acid descaling
filtrationMembranes.description: Fine-pore ceramic ultrafiltration system that retains large colloidal pectins, tannins, and suspended proteins while allowing monomeric polyphenols, flavonoids, and catechins to permeate freely.

quenchSystems.name: Sanitary Counter-Current Chilled Glycol Tube-in-Tube Heat Exchanger
quenchSystems.antioxidantShieldingEffect: Excellent (instantaneous quenching stops thermal cleavage and Maillard browning)
quenchSystems.description: Multi-pass sanitary dual-tube heat exchanger circulating -2°C food-grade propylene glycol in counter-current flow, cooling the pressurized extract from 170°C down to 24°C in under 2.2 seconds.

quenchSystems.name: Hastelloy C-22 Sanitary Microchannel Plate Quencher
quenchSystems.antioxidantShieldingEffect: Ultra-High (sub-second thermal quench preserves 98%+ of fragile anthocyanins)
quenchSystems.description: Diffusion-bonded Hastelloy microchannel heat exchanger with micro-fluidic cooling passages providing heat transfer coefficients exceeding 8,500 W/m²·K for rapid preservation of heat-sensitive flavonoids.

quenchSystems.name: Unassisted Ambient Atmospheric Flash Expansion (Process Warning)
quenchSystems.antioxidantShieldingEffect: Critical Warning (prolonged high temperature causes 30%+ anthocyanin thermal degradation and oxidation)
quenchSystems.description: Extract flashes into atmospheric collection vessel without active chilled quenching. High residual heat and exposure to atmospheric oxygen rapidly destroys antioxidant potency and forms dark pyrolytic off-colors.

scientificFormulas.waterDielectricConstant: ε(T) = 5321/T + 233.76 - 0.9297*T + 0.001417*(T^2) - 8.292e-7*(T^3) [Uematsu-Franck subcritical formulation at saturation pressure]
scientificFormulas.totalPhenolicContentRecovery: TPC_rec = TPC_max * (1 - exp(-k_ext * t_res)) * exp(-k_deg * t_res)
scientificFormulas.thermalDegradationKineticConstant: k_deg(T) = A_deg * exp(-Ea / (R * (T + 273.15))) [Arrhenius thermal degradation model]
scientificFormulas.pressureSafetyFactor: SF_press = ASME_MAWP / P_operating (Minimum safety factor 1.25x for pressure vessels)
